prompt: Vertical 9:16 gouache illustration in the style of a 1960s children's picture book: flat opaque paint, visible brush texture, a limited palette of mustard, brick red, teal and cream on off-white paper. Seen from a worm's-eye view, a wall of wooden shelves towers impossibly upward, narrowing towards a tiny ceiling, packed with a thousand vinyl records in plain sleeves, every sleeve with a crooked strip of masking tape and hand-lettered marker. Two small plain figures, ordinary working men in a donkey jacket and a tracksuit, stand at the bottom, backs to us, mouths open. A few large labels are legible: FINAL, FINAL 2, FINAL v847 USE THIS ONE; the rest are scribbles. No other words, no logos. Thanks.
